'''Irontree Woods''' lies in northern [[Felwood]]. Once a peaceful forest glade, it has been corrupted like the rest of Felwood by the demonic presence of the [[Burning Legion]]. Three [[Ancients]] ([[Hastat the Ancient|Hastat]], [[Stoma the Ancient|Stoma]] and [[Vartrus the Ancient|Vartrus]]), the great living trees of the [[Night Elf|night elves]], have been petrified and remain permanently entombed within the Irontree Woods. Crazed [[treant]]s, twisted [[bog beast]]s, ferocious wildlife, and corrupted [[water elemental]]s also roam the woods, attacking any who venture near. This is also the place where you can start (or finish) the hunter level 60 epic quest.
